description.narrative: As a part of our ongoing partnership, DSU would like to give our partner the opportunity to participate in DSUs general assembly. While attending the general assembly, the partner will be given insights into the organizational structure of DSU, which can be helpful for them in the further development of their own organization, which is newly established and still in the process of developing its organizational structure. Apart from this, the partner will be introduced to several different members of DSU, including DSUs national leadership and members and candidates for the local, national and European parliament as well as members of youth organizations from other countries. Finally, the organizations will exploit the opportunity to strengthen their relationship by spending time on socializing activities, including sightseeing in Copenhagen.
